claims.quote: Stepping to the *Telephot* on the side of the wall he pressed a group of buttons and in a few minutes the faceplate of the Telephot became luminous, revealing the face of a clean shaven man about thirty, a pleasant but serious face.
claims.description: A wall-mounted video telephone connects callers face to face over long distances.

claims.quote: He immediately turned the small shining disc of the Language Rectifier on his instrument till the pointer rested on
claims.description: A device on the video phone translates a foreign speaker's language in real time.

claims.quote: When both instruments were connected he signed his name and he saw his signature appear simultaneously on the machine in Switzerland.
claims.description: A telautograph attached to the video phone reproduces a handwritten signature at a distant location instantly.

claims.quote: The delicate detectophone mechanism of the Luminor responded instantly to her command; and the room was flooded at once with the beautiful cold pink-white Luminor-light, emanating from the thin wire running around the four sides of the room below the white ceiling.
claims.description: Voice-controlled cold electric lighting from a wire around the room, dimmable by spoken command.

claims.quote: It must be a dreadful predicament to be cut off from the entire world, in these days of weather control.
claims.description: Humanity controls the weather by technology.

claims.quote: they simultaneously turned on the high-depression at the four Meteoro-Towers and then fled, leaving their towers with the high-tension currents escaping at a tremendous rate.
claims.description: Electrical Meteoro-Towers generate high- and low-pressure weather over a district, even causing snowfall in summer.

claims.quote: no aeroflyer could come near the house
claims.description: Personal flying vehicles (aeroflyers) are in everyday use.

claims.quote: Both the Power mast and the Communico mast were blown down the same day, and I was left without any means of communication whatever.
claims.description: Homes receive broadcast electric power and communications via masts.

claims.quote: one of the ten men on the whole planet earth permitted to use the Plus sign after his name
claims.description: Only ten top scientists on Earth are granted a special honorific rank, the Plus sign.

claims.quote: *Hypnobioscope*, the purpose of which is to acquire knowledge while asleep
claims.description: A device teaches knowledge to a sleeping person (commentary noting a prediction since realized in limited form).

claims.quote: Ralph explains, as of the year 2660, the resuscitation of animal (human) life years after the body has been drained of blood.
claims.description: Humans can be revived years after their blood is drained (commentary describing the book's prediction).

claims.quote: we shall reap four crops of wheat per year in sun-heated glass houses of county-sized acreage, to feed the new billions.
claims.description: Huge sun-heated glass houses yield four wheat crops a year (commentary describing the book's prediction).

claims.quote: Ralph insisted, even in 1911, that gravitation is indeed wave form, similar to the electromagnetic, and that by interference there—between the force of gravitation may be partially nullified.
claims.description: Gravity can be partially cancelled by wave interference (commentary describing the book's prediction).

claims.quote: The writer's most famous hit, of course, is *radar* (p. 152), which no one else had come near to conceiving at the time.
claims.description: Radar-like detection is described in the book (commentary noting the prediction).

claims.quote: No author laying his story in the future would think today of doing without Mr. […]'s three-dimensional color television, and very few without his satellite city circling the Earth
claims.description: Three-dimensional color television and an Earth-orbiting satellite city (commentary describing the book's predictions).
